name: Drunkeness
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of drunkenness, illustrating through Noah's experience that excessive drinking leads to shame and vulnerability. Proverbs highlights that wine and strong drink can deceive and provoke reckless behavior, revealing a lack of wisdom in those who fall into its snare. Furthermore, Romans urges believers to avoid anything, including wine, that might cause a fellow Christian to stumble or become weak, emphasizing love and responsibility within the body of Christ.
